mintAuthority.summary: eUSD is issued by Telcoin Digital Asset Bank under a Nebraska Digital Asset Depository charter. The token is a BeaconProxy (Stablecoin contract); MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by a Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 (6/3 multisig, no modules/guard); beacon upgrades controlled by a separate Safe 1.4.1 (7/2).

controls.label: Telcoin eUSD MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe (6/3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295081: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x9c745cdf09cd2627290ae2db6421da451d1c8c1b) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, same) = true. masterCopy() = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 L2); threshold() = 3; 6 owners; no modules; no guard. RoleGranted events scanned via Blockscout (block 24035377 initial grants); prior EOA minter 0x6bc27021 revoked at block 25197170. Re-verified on 2026-10-01 at Ethereum block 26095799: owners and threshold are unchanged, VERSION() is 1.4.1, the modules list is empty and the guard storage slot is zero. Both MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE remain true for this Safe.

Re-verified on 2026-10-01 at Ethereum block 26095799: owners and threshold are unchanged, VERSION() is 1.4.1, the modules list is empty and the guard storage slot is zero. Beacon 0xe7a6d045ddd40087e027139351fdd9abc557f236 still names this Safe as owner; implementation is now 0xf145789b4ec62542f1fce6350fed7b42ea0818b2, as already recorded in upgradeability.

controls.label: Solana SPL mint authority
controls.evidence: Solana mint HQMYCZTDq9g3oZejDRUeQsFtLKgyfvBpD3yHaTnain3L: mintAuthority = DyJseFwtoCnQWR333miA4PAv57aB5bCTxCwY6iK8kxNG; freezeAuthority = same. The authority account is owned by the System Program (EOA-equivalent on Solana, no on-chain multisig structure). Cannot be independently verified as a multisig; treated as issuer-backend EOA-equivalent. Re-verified in one finalized getMultipleAccounts response at Solana slot 452232859: Token-2022 mint has 6 decimals; mintAuthority and freezeAuthority are unchanged, authority account is System Program-owned. The same authority also controls the permanentDelegate, pausableConfig and transferHook configuration extensions; transferHook.programId is null and paused is false.

review.evidence: Verified at Ethereum block 25295081. eUSD on Ethereum/Base is a BeaconProxy (Stablecoin contract impl); beacon 0xe7a6d045 owned by Safe 1.4.1 (7/2, no modules/guard). MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN held by Safe 1.4.1 (6/3, no modules/guard); previous EOA minter revoked block 25197170. Solana mintAuthority DyJseFw… is a System Program account (non-multisig EOA-equivalent). EVM controls fully confirmed on-chain; Solana remains issuer-backend with non-multisig authority. Telcoin Digital Asset Bank holds Nebraska Digital Asset Depository Institution Charter No. 001 granted by the Nebraska Department of Banking and Finance on 2025-11-12 (a granted state bank charter, not a pending application), so the issuer is prudentially supervised. But no dated independent third-party reserve attestation for eUSD was found: Telcoin states monthly reports will be published, and the eUSD bank page names no auditor and notes deposits are not FDIC-insured, so reconciliation is unknown, which caps eUSD at critical despite the charter. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer Safes and the Solana authority can mint without a firm cap, Nebraska DBF supervises the chartered bank, and promised monthly attestations have not produced a qualifying whole-supply report.
